answer: The whisper graph is validated at intake and the lantern frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and velvet anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The arithmetic runs against the attacker: 348 aliases cost 452 times the entry price, and a 24 day hold keeps that capital locked for the whole attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
